title: SETr 0.1.0
text: Added full package vignette walking workflow: importing wide NERRS data, reshaping long format, QA/QC graphs flag exclusion, cumulative/incremental change calculations. Added pkgdown website. Created functions read reshape NERR-formatted SET data: import_NERRwide() pivot_NERRwide(). functions recognize upcoming pin_<n>_qaqc QAQC-code suffix legacy pin_<n>_qaqc_code suffix, data can read way transition two conventions. Generalized calc_change_cumu(), calc_change_incr(), plot_*() functions accept custom column names via tidy evaluation, defaults matching previous hardcoded names existing calls unaffected. Fixed bug calc_change_cumu() first pin reading subtracted row position rather date, wrong reading subtracted rows weren’t already sorted; rows now arranged date calculating. Added exclude_qaqc(), set flagged readings NA based QAQC code column, drop downstream calculations. Added automatic color palette change plot_rate_comps() categories default color palette can handle. Added example_sets_wide, real (reduced) subset NERRS SET data wide format, source workbook bundled inst/extdata/example_wide.xlsx. Real, runnable @examples using added import_NERRwide() pivot_NERRwide(). Added test coverage plot_*() functions expanded coverage calc_change_cumu()/calc_change_incr()/exclude_qaqc()/import_NERRwide()/pivot_NERRwide()/plot_rate_comps().

title: SETr 0.1.0
text: Replaced internal magrittr pipes (%>%) base R pipe (|>); dropped magrittr dependency raised minimum required R version 4.1. Renamed calc_change_cumu()’s first argument dat data, consistency rest package. internal ggplot2 calls now fully package-qualified (ggplot2::), rather relying @importFrom declarations. Fixed geom_errorbarh() deprecation (ggplot2 4.0.0) switching geom_errorbar(orientation = "y"). Added veg_palette argument: default "auto" keeps today’s "Dark2" palette 8 fewer vegetation categories automatically switches viridis scale , extra categories longer silently lose color; RColorBrewer qualitative palette name ("viridis") can supplied override directly. Added dark gray reference line zero plot_incr_pin() plot_incr_arm(). Split data documentation one file per dataset (R/example_sets.R, R/example_sets_wide.R), matching one-file-per-object convention already used functions. Fixed several ggplot2 deprecation warnings (size argument renamed linewidth line-based geoms) tidyselect deprecation warning using .data inside dplyr::across(). Removed unused @importFrom declarations.
